remaining.description: Problems still in the published plan, and what the design shows that the data lacks

id.description: The id of the designer's note, as frame.load listed it

status.description: addressed: done, and detail says how. not-addressed: not done, and detail says why. not-mine: the note is for the other stage (frame-match: look and layout; bind: data)

detail.description: What was done, or why not

notes.description: One entry for each note the designer left (bind.load lists them): met, or why not. [] when it listed none

created.description: Providers and connectors this run had hook-maker create in Cast, which every hook there can use (code's, from hook-maker's answers)

data.description: bound: its data is the design's; stand-in: bound to data about something else (another team), shown for the shape; none: nothing was bound. Set by code, never by the model

dataWhy.description: Why the data is a stand-in, or why nothing was bound (code's, never the model's)

static.description: Nothing on the frame is data, so nothing was bound (bind.static)

kept.description: What the published plan keeps as designed, with why (bind.publish's, never the model's)

despite.description: Why it was published with problems open, when it was

sources.description: Where the data came from, as the plan's artifacts record it (bind.publish's, never the model's)
